statements: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.stripe_payment_events (event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (char_length(event_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 255), event_type TEXT NOT NULL, checkout_session_id TEXT, payment_intent_id TEXT, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending','processing','processed','failed')), attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (attempts >= 0), claim_expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ, processed_at TIMESTAMPTZ, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW())
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stripe_payment_events_pending ON public.stripe_payment_events (status, claim_expires_at) WHERE status IN ('pending','processing','failed')
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stripe_payment_events_session ON public.stripe_payment_events (checkout_session_id) WHERE checkout_session_id IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stripe_payment_events_intent ON public.stripe_payment_events (payment_intent_id) WHERE payment_intent_id IS NOT NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.order_email_deliveries (order_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES public.orders (order_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, recipient_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (recipient_kind IN ('customer','owner')), status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending','sending','sent','failed')), attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (attempts >= 0), claim_expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ, provider_message_id TEXT, sent_at TIMESTAMPTZ, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), PRIMARY KEY (order_id, recipient_kind))
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_order_email_deliveries_pending ON public.order_email_deliveries (status, claim_expires_at) WHERE status IN ('pending','sending','failed')
